name: Hotel Krone
beschreibung: Hotel Krone is situated right in the centre of Matrei am Brenner within Tyrol's scenic Wipptal Valley. The surrounding mountains offer extensive summer hiking trails and quick access to the family-friendly Bergeralm ski resort in winter. The historic hotel features a restaurant serving authentic Tyrolean specialties and a soothing wellness area with sauna. Guest rooms combine traditional alpine charm with modern convenience, supported by excellent transport connections.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Krone in central Matrei am Brenner provides classic Tyrolean hospitality, a sauna wellness area, regional dining, and easy access to Bergeralm ski slopes.
